title: Apartment Design 64 m² in Kraków, minimalist
description: 64 m² minimalist apartment in Kraków: design project, 3D visualisation, custom furniture and turnkey renovation. DUMSKAYA DESIGN, Bratislava and Vienna.

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) developed the interior design for a 64 m² apartment in a contemporary minimalist style. The concept is based on functionality, clean architectural lines, a calm color palette and visual consistency throughout the interior.

The design combines neutral grey tones, clean lines and minimalist forms. The restrained color palette creates a calm background, while different textures and materials add depth and character without introducing unnecessary decorative elements.

Particular attention was given to architectural details. Concealed doors without visible frames or architraves are integrated into the wall surfaces, supporting the minimalist character of the interior. Laconic furniture solutions and built-in elements help maintain clean geometry while making efficient use of the available space.

The layout and interior solutions were developed with a strong focus on ergonomics and everyday comfort. Each element forms part of the overall composition, allowing the apartment to be perceived as a cohesive contemporary living space.
The project includes the development of the interior concept, photorealistic 3D visualizations and technical documentation required for the subsequent implementation of the proposed design solutions.
